title: Rabbi Antigenos

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Horayot, chapter 3, halakhah 4, where Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi speaks in his name. Hyman calls the Rabbi Antigenos reading in the Mekhilta, Massekhta deVayehi, Beshalach, a scribal error and says the reading should be: “Rabbi said: Antoninus,” etc.[^1]

notes.text: The complete Jerusalem Talmud Horayot 3:4 paragraph explicitly has Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi reporting in Rabbi Antigonos’s name. Hyman’s Mekhilta error diagnosis and his asserted replacement “Rabbi said: Antoninus” remain attributed textual judgments. The intended Mekhilta passage and edition were not independently established; the search removed its book filter and cannot prove either the reading or absence.
